The main takeaway from our work is that

the proton transport pathways in the MPA and Tri complex can be understood by DFT calculations, and the proton transport pathways of the polymeric blend of PVTri and PVPA can be understood in terms of the proton transport pathways observed in the MPTri complex.

the proton transport pathways in acid-base complexes consisting of a phosphonate acid group and a heteroaromatic group such as 1,2-triazole are very different from the pathways in pure phosphonic acid polymers or in pure 1,2-azole polymers.
the acid-base complex consisting a phosphonic acid and a 1H-1-2,3-tri-azole is promising for proton transport applications.
